::: {.page-intro}
# Urban Space &amp; Environmental Processes
<p class="lede">How do spatial conditions and interventions produce environmental effects, and how do these effects change across time, scale and climate?</p>
:::

::: {.prose .research-thread-page}
<p class="meta">01 · 城市空间与环境过程</p>

## From space to process

Urban form, blue-green spaces, trees, shading and other spatial interventions continually shape urban thermal environments and microclimatic processes. This thread examines how these effects emerge, vary and stabilize across time, scale, background climate and extreme events.

## Conceptual scope

Blue-green spaces, trees and shading, urban morphology, public spaces and urban redevelopment are recurring objects for understanding spatial-environmental relationships. This page presents a research trajectory established through published work, not current projects.
